name: codex-goals
description: Drive Codex's native iterate-until-done loop with the stable Goals feature — define the objective once, let Codex own the loop. Triggers: codex goals, iterate until done, codex autodev, define the goal and let it run, Codex-native operating loop, the codex /goals slash command, first-class loop primitive for codex.

triggers: define the goal and let it run
replace a codex exec re-prompt harness
unattended codex worker on a durable objective

references.description: Self-check: frontmatter + name==dir + line-start Triggers marker + section spine + Form-A line budget (<=250) + the 'codex exec -a' anti-pattern guard + currency of the 'goals' feature. Exit 0 on pass.

sources.description: codex-cli 0.137.0 verified live: 'codex features list' shows goals=stable=true; 'codex doctor' reports 'goals DB ~/.codex/goals_1.sqlite integrity ok'; ~/.codex/config.toml has goals=true. codex exec --help confirms -s {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, --json, -o/--output-last-message, resume --last, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox — and confirms codex exec has NO -a flag (errors 'unexpected argument -a'); -a/--ask-for-approval is interactive-codex only.

backstage-stays-backstage (operator-side jargon never reaches clients); never claude -p for worker dispatch (API billing vs Max sub); publish-on-convergence (cross-agent awareness = published compressions); a goal MUST have a machine-checkable done-condition.
